stories.title: Sources: Wolves' Edwards to miss up to 2 months after arthroscopic knee procedure
stories.summary: Timberwolves star Anthony Edwards will undergo an arthroscopic procedure on his ailing right knee that will sideline him up to two months, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.
